🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very weak sector breadth (2/11) and pervasive large-cap weakness with major Tech and Healthcare names BELOW TREND, supporting the RISK-OFF call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +4.02% | 1M: +20.39%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing short-term strength: WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Mixed (Top 5 span Tech, Energy, Financials).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, EXC (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Industrials pressured: NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND. Tech broadly weak with mega-caps BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY, SLB (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%) RECOVERY. Leadership concentration: Mixed across 3 sectors (Tech, Energy, Financials) — not narrowly concentrated but not broadly diversified.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, PSA (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials, Utilities and select Healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY. Note divergence: semiconductors (LRCX, AMAT, AMD) showing 1W bounces while mega-cap Tech (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL) remain BELOW TREND — tactical momentum not yet broad.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed-to-weak: NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) BELOW TREND; pockets of RECOVERY in semiconductors: LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%) RECOVERY. Sector momentum currently narrow and not confirming broad Tech leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing short-term resilience but mixed trend: XOM? (Energy context) — core Financials: GS (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%) RECOVERY, MS (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%) RECOVERY, JPM (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%) RECOVERY. Financials offer tactical strength within an otherwise risk-off market; breadth within Financials remains mixed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure: LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -4.21%) BELOW TREND; exceptions: PFE (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%) ABOVE TREND. Watch biotech/large-cap pharma for headline-driven volatility.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor reducing exposure to high-beta Growth/Tech names (NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND) and Consumer Discretionary exposure; favor Energy majors showing ABOVE TREND strength (OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +9.17%) ABOVE TREND) and selective Financials with RECOVERY momentum. Style: Value/Cyclical favored in the current RISK-OFF environment.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NEM (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +10.31%) — concentration of ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -3.80%), Materials (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -10.87%) — broad weakness and deep drawdowns.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming 1M momentum is required to consider stabilization. Monitor OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent highs; failure would temper Energy leadership. LRCX (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%) RECOVERY hold of this week's gap will indicate continued semiconductor rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+60): Positive Phase 3 ADorable-1 topline; price (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND — news bullish but price diverging, monitor for follow-through. VST (+55): Dual upgrades headline; price (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%) BELOW TREND — sentiment not yet reflected in price, watch for fundamental confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
WMT (-50): Retail warning; price (1W: -5.73% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price weakness. TSLA (-45): Legal headline; price (1W: -5.94% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned, elevated downside risk. WFC (-40): Housing/capital concerns; price (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%) RECOVERY — bearish news contrasts with short-term bounce, watch for reversal.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF; Style: Value/Cyclical favored. OXY (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND show Tech vulnerability. Key risk: major divergence between bullish headlines (e.g., LLY +60) and falling prices — watch for distribution or failed bounces.
